policies.text: Standard shipping takes 4 business days. Shipping is free for orders over 75 USD.
Unused items may be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Approved refunds are issued within 5 business days.
Support is available Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 18:00 UTC.
Products include a 12 month warranty for manufacturing defects.
International shipping is available to Canada and the United Kingdom.
